mapper.insert: insert into abr_touch_log (task_id, agent_code, target_type, target_id, channel, category, status, reason, content_ref, create_time) values (#{taskId}, #{agentCode}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{channel}, #{category}, #{status}, coalesce(#{reason}, ''), #{contentRef}, now())
mapper.select: select count(*) from abr_touch_log where target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId} and category = 'marketing' and status = 'sent' and create_time >= #{since}
select agent_code from abr_touch_log where target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId} and status = 'sent' and create_time >= #{since} order by touch_id desc limit 1
select exists (select 1 from abr_touch_optout where target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId} and scope = #{scope})
mapper.insert: insert into abr_touch_optout (target_type, target_id, scope, source, reason, create_by, create_time) values (#{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{scope}, #{source}, coalesce(#{reason}, ''), coalesce(#{createBy}, ''), now()) on conflict (target_type, target_id, scope) do nothing
mapper.delete: delete from abr_touch_optout where target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId} and scope = #{scope}
